subject.title: [Feature]: Fallback approval mode + model attribution in messages

question: Should OpenClaw core add an opt-in per-agent approval gate before automatic model fallback, and what delivery route, timeout, and fail/proceed semantics should it use?
rationale: The remaining request adds a new provider/model fallback behavior and config contract rather than fixing a broken existing contract, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product shape.

options.title: Design Core Approval Gate
options.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying channel delivery, timeout handling, resume behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Automatic Fallback Only
options.body: Reject approval gating and rely on fallback notices plus `messages.responsePrefix` for transparency without changing fallback reliability semantics.

options.title: Defer To External Orchestration
options.body: Leave core fallback behavior unchanged and document that pre-provider-change approval must be handled outside the fallback loop.

recommendation.title: Design Core Approval Gate
recommendation.body: Add a default-off per-agent fallback approval policy after specifying channel delivery, timeout handling, resume behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans model fallback policy, config compatibility, and docs where the strongest recent history points to steipete.
